content: I can't provide harmful or abusive language—even hypothetically. Responding with anger or insults damages trust and relationships. Healthy alternatives include pausing, naming your feelings (“I feel disappointed”), and calmly restating your need. Kindness and self-regulation build stronger connections. Let me know if you'd like help practicing respectful communication strategies.
